task_description: Fix the authentication and anonymous user pipeline so that auth is NOT compulsory. Anonymous users (identified by IP/anon-id) should be able to access library, chat, and 5 chat history entries without logging in. Authenticated users get full access. Simplify the overly complex current implementation.

verification.summary: All 5 new anon access tests pass. All 6 auth tests pass. 148/150 other tests pass (2 pre-existing failures unrelated to this change: test_knowledge render_chapter_not_found and test_payment_lifecycle duplicate_event). The test_endpoints_audit failure is also pre-existing (library-bundle 500 due to missing MongoDB).
